name: Chat answer
purpose: Shows GOV.UK Chat's answer to a question, on a white card the width of the conversation, with the GOV.UK pages it used and a warning to check them. Also GOV.UK Chat's welcome message, at the start of a new chat.

origin.notes: ChatCellView's answer and intro: a card in fills.surfaceChatAnswer, padded 16pt, its corners rounded 18pt. An answer with sources has, below a divider in strokes.chatDivider, SF's exclamationmark.circle.fill and GOV.UK Chat can make mistakes, in Body, semibold, then a disclosure group listing the pages, each an underlined link in text.linkSecondary, with dividers between them. The app draws the answer itself from Markdown; here it's written with the library's text, heading, bulleted list and link. The Android app's Answer and Sources are the same, with Material's info icon in place of the exclamation mark.

note.description: A note below the message, in small grey text, 24pt below it, as the welcome message says Messages will be saved for 90 days.

sources-open.description: Draws the list of GOV.UK pages open. The app starts it closed, and the user opens it.

inputs.content: The answer, written with <govuk-app-text>, <govuk-app-heading level="3" size="body"> and <govuk-app-bulleted-list spacing="compact">, with <govuk-app-link> for links in them. Then a <govuk-app-chat-source href="…"> for each GOV.UK page it used, holding the page's title. With sources, it draws the warning and the list of pages.

govuk-app-chat-source.description: One GOV.UK page the answer used, holding the page's title, listed under the answer.

events.name: toggle
events.description: From the list of GOV.UK pages, a <details>, when the user opens or closes it.

events.name: click
events.description: From a link in the answer, or a GOV.UK page in its list, when it's pressed.

rules: Follow each question with its answer.
Give an answer the GOV.UK pages it used, as the app's answers have, so the warning to check them is shown. Leave them off only to show an answer the app couldn't find pages for.
Write the answer as GOV.UK Chat would: short paragraphs, headings in Body, semibold, and lists, with links to GOV.UK pages.
Start a new chat with the welcome message: Hi, I’m GOV.UK Chat 👋. I use AI to help you find what you need on GOV.UK., with the note Messages will be saved for 90 days. Leave its sources off.

avoid.when: While the answer is being generated
For text on a screen that isn't GOV.UK Chat

references.description: The welcome message, then an answer with its list of pages open, in light mode
An answer's headings and lists, in light mode
An answer without sources, in light mode
The welcome message alone, in a new chat, in light mode

examples.name: With the pages it used
examples.html:
<govuk-app-chat-answer sources-open>
  <govuk-app-text>You can renew your passport online. It costs £94.50 and usually takes up to 3 weeks.</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-text>You’ll need a <govuk-app-link href="https://www.gov.uk/photos-for-passports">digital photo</govuk-app-link> and a credit or debit card.</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/renew-adult-passport">Renew or replace your adult passport</govuk-app-chat-source>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/passport-fees">Passport fees</govuk-app-chat-source>
</govuk-app-chat-answer>

examples.name: Its pages closed, as the app starts it
examples.html:

  <govuk-app-text>You can renew your passport online. It costs £94.50 and usually takes up to 3 weeks.</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/renew-adult-passport">Renew or replace your adult passport</govuk-app-chat-source>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/passport-fees">Passport fees</govuk-app-chat-source>

examples.name: With headings and lists
examples.html:
<govuk-app-chat-answer>
  <govuk-app-text>There are different ways to get a passport, depending on whether it’s your first adult passport or you’re renewing one.</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-heading level="3" size="body">First adult passport</govuk-app-heading>
  <govuk-app-text>You can apply online or with a paper form. Applying online:</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-bulleted-list spacing="compact">
    <govuk-app-bulleted-list-item>costs £94.50</govuk-app-bulleted-list-item>
    <govuk-app-bulleted-list-item>needs a <govuk-app-link href="https://www.gov.uk/photos-for-passports">digital photo</govuk-app-link> and someone to confirm your identity</govuk-app-bulleted-list-item>
  </govuk-app-bulleted-list>
  <govuk-app-heading level="3" size="body">Renewing a passport</govuk-app-heading>
  <govuk-app-text>You can <govuk-app-link href="https://www.gov.uk/renew-adult-passport">renew your passport online</govuk-app-link>.</govuk-app-text>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/apply-first-adult-passport">Apply for your first adult passport</govuk-app-chat-source>
  <govuk-app-chat-source href="https://www.gov.uk/renew-adult-passport">Renew or replace your adult passport</govuk-app-chat-source>
</govuk-app-chat-answer>

examples.name: Without sources
examples.html:
<govuk-app-chat-answer>
  <govuk-app-text>Sorry, I cannot answer that. Try asking about something on GOV.UK.</govuk-app-text>
</govuk-app-chat-answer>

examples.name: The welcome message
examples.html:
<govuk-app-chat-answer note="Messages will be saved for 90 days.">
  <govuk-app-text>Hi, I’m GOV.UK Chat 👋. I use AI to help you find what you need on GOV.UK.</govuk-app-text>
</govuk-app-chat-answer>
